metadata.description: Claude Code skills and agents from Nick Tierney, for R, Quarto, and blogging workflows.

plugins.name: blogdown-to-quarto
plugins.description: Migrate blogdown/hugodown (Hugo) R blogs to Quarto: agent + skill covering theme replication, sitemap-validated URL preservation, and GitHub Pages deployment, plus a standalone migration script.

plugins.name: r-analysis
plugins.description: House style for R analysis projects, four interlocking skills: project conventions (conflicted, fs, air, layout), function design (check_ functions, decomposition), targets pipelines (tar_assign, file targets, workspace debugging, crew), and code comments (three-stage test plus audit pass).

plugins.name: reprex
plugins.description: Write minimal reproducible examples for R bug reports and GitHub issues: lead with the code, the .R file as source of truth, minimality as a discipline.
